post.description: To find FCC equipment authorization filings by grantee, applicant, date range or technical filters; use lookup_fcc_id for one exact FCC ID.

applicant_name.description: Applicant / grantee name (the site matches a prefix).

application_purpose.description:
I = Change in FCC ID, P = Class II Permissive Change, S = Class III Permissive Change, O = Original Grant.

Provider reference: allowed values ["I", "P", "S", "O"].

application_status.description:
granted (default: all granted statuses), all (grants, dismissals and denials), GI (grant issued), IP (permissive change issued), IM (modification of FCC ID issued), DM (dismissed), DN (denied).

Provider reference: allowed values ["granted", "all", "GI", "IP", "IM", "DM", "DN"].

cursor.description: Continuation from a previous page (meta.page.next_cursor): the site's 1-based FromRec offset of the next page.

equipment_class.description: Numeric equipment class code from the site's search form select (e.g. 103 = DTS Digital Transmission System). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,4}$.

final_action_date_from.description: Earliest final action (grant) date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

final_action_date_to.description: Latest final action (grant) date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

grantee_code.description: Grantee code (3 or 5 characters), e.g. IPH.

lower_frequency_mhz.description:
Lower frequency filter in MHz.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

modular_type.description:
1 single modular, 2 limited single modular, 3 split modular, 4 limited split modular approval.

Provider reference: allowed values ["1", "2", "3", "4"].

page_size.description:
Rows per page (the form's show_records; 500 accepted by the site).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 25.

product_code.description: Product code (the FCC ID after the grantee code, hyphen included), up to 14 characters; prefix match unless product_exact_match.

product_exact_match.description: Match product_code exactly instead of as a prefix.

rule_parts.description: Up to 3 FCC rule parts as the form lists them (e.g. 15C, 22H, 90).

tcb_code.description: Telecommunication Certification Body code, e.g. US0101.

tcb_scope.description: TCB scope code A1..A4, B1..B4. Pattern: ^[AB][1-4]$.

upper_frequency_mhz.description:
Upper frequency filter in MHz.

Provider reference: minimum 0.
